description: Check a list of logged service/volunteer hours for internal consistency: bad dates, non-positive or impossible day totals, missing organization, and days above this service's 8-hour flag. Deterministic arithmetic only - no AI. It does NOT decide whether the hours satisfy any school or award requirement.

as_of.description: Treat this date as "today" (YYYY-MM-DD) when rejecting future dates. Defaults to the server date.

entries.description: Entries to check. Each: {date:"YYYY-MM-DD", hours:number, activity:"what was done", organization:"where", category?:"tutoring", notes?}.

name: check_hours
